# Round fairground plaza: a 10-sided tiled disc (r 5) in a grass ring (r 6.2), a lavender kerb, an earth underside. Up Z.
new
add mesh cylinder --name Plaza --vertices 10 --radius 5.0 --depth 0.3 --location 0 0 -0.15
material new Tiles --base-color 1 1 1
material new Kerb --base-color 0.514 0.463 0.612 --no-slot
material slot add
active Plaza
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
material assign Kerb
# the checker: 10 texels over the 10 m top (1 m tiles, ~11 splats a side), projected from above
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Tiles base-color textures/tiles.png
# the grass ring sits 0.15 lower, so the plaza's kerb shows a full splat step above it
add mesh cylinder --name Grass --vertices 10 --radius 6.2 --depth 0.4 --location 0 0 -0.35
material new Grass --base-color 0 0.894 0.212
material new Earth --base-color 0.671 0.322 0.212 --no-slot
active Grass
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < 0.9"
material assign Earth
mode object
add mesh cone --name Under --vertices 10 --radius1 0.8 --radius2 6.1 --depth 2.2 --location 0 0 -1.65
material assign Earth
active Under
mode edit
select vert where "pos.z < -0.5"
randomize --amount 0.3 --seed 4
mode object
select all
shade flat
export plaza.glb
